summary: Iterates over input bytes one at a time, feeding each through StreamByteOutputWithBufferManagement, and stops when the shared status dword at a4 becomes -1.

operations.description: Initialize result cursor from a2; loop index i starts one dword behind a2.
Loop while the result cursor (as signed int) remains positive, decrementing the index each pass.
Read next byte from a1 and pass it to StreamByteOutputWithBufferManagement with a3 and a4.
Break out of the loop when the dword at a4 equals -1 (terminator/error sentinel).

unresolved: Exact roles of a2 (count vs pointer), a3 (output buffer), and a4 (shared status) are not stated by the raw source.
Why the loop cursor is typed as a pointer-minus-one while compared as signed int is not derivable from this function alone.
